title: Living Town: model, resident life and authoritative core
initial_mode: Normal resident selector. Before the timed tour, public LifeMode.start_life(aria), speed key3, real waiting to tick90, pause key0 and LifeMode.begin_select() establish morning without relocating Aria. The pre-roll is included in the measured boot prefix and trimmed from delivery.
boot_prefix: Report movie_boot_frames_to_trim from Engine.get_frames_drawn at the defined tour start. Trim that many captured boot frames before the600-second narration timeline. Verify actual output frame count independently.

camera_api.owner: Harness priority49, between LifeMode priority0 and WorldView3D priority50
camera_api.interpolation: Smoothstep of integer tour frame/FPS, independent of OS wall clock and Sim tick rewinds
camera_api.inspections: Presentation only: pause LifeMode processing/HUD and hide observer cards; keep the chapter label. Restore before real input. No actor address or clock edits.
camera_api.coordinate_system: Camera centers are canonical px through the existing projection; geography listed below is original Blender XY meters.

chapters.title: Town and coast
actions: Pause through existing KEY_0; hide only initial resident selection panel.
Smooth camera survey of whole current town, irregular frontages, coast and vegetation.

chapters.title: Choose an existing resident
actions: Show original resident selector at45s.
At50s call the same public LifeMode.start_life(aria) used by its selection button.
Pause via KEY_0 while inspecting the actual upper home and live HUD.

chapters.title: Stairs, walking and needs
actions: Resume via KEY_1.
Actual screen click + numeric menu selection traverses p_cafe_stairs.
Full route only: click the actual cafe table, choose its real advertised meal, observe completion and need effect. Preview retains stairs and tests the later counter action.

chapters.title: The actual cafe counter
actions: Click the imported counter mesh.
Accept a canonical alias only when nonempty model_asset_id and plane exactly match.
Show the original action menu, choose its first legal action by actual key event, observe real use/completion and advertised need or wage change.
Pause after completion for a readable resulting HUD.

chapters.title: Street, thresholds and visibility
actions: Resume and traverse p_cafe_door through actual mouse/key input.
Capture current controlled-resident occlusion state and visible silhouette at the threshold.
Full route only: choose a nearby actually reachable dry street cell and click it through LifeMode.
Pause through normal UI before architectural inspections.

chapters.title: Architectural inspection: rooms
actions: Pause only LifeMode presentation processing and hide its resident HUD.
Read-only Probe active plane/center/zoom reveals library1f, home1f and hotel2f; no actor relocation or portal traversal is implied.
Local covers change only for the inspected building; native GLB remains unchanged.

chapters.title: Architectural inspection: streets
actions: Camera glides from adjoining inland houses through central streets to working harbor.
Whole exterior covers restored when the Probe returns to town/outdoor.
Irregular streets, grounded terrain/pads and tree-lined routes are inspected as architecture.

chapters.title: Architectural inspection: pond
actions: Camera approaches the actual park pond, then pulls toward planted coastal paths.
This is a view of authored pond/bank/planting geometry, not hydrology or resident swimming.

chapters.title: Resident agency and autonomous life
actions: Restore normal LifeMode presentation and real resident plane before any input.
Full route attempts a same-plane resident interaction through an actual sprite click and original legal menu option; response is not forced.
Enable autonomy with KEY_F and observe the existing core clock/resident decisions.

chapters.title: Save, resume and restore
actions: Disable autonomy with KEY_F before saving; close any menu.
Pause through KEY_0 and press F5 to invoke existing Main quicksave.
Resume actual simulation, pause again and press F8.
Observe synchronous world_reset with the saved tick/address/profile identity, then resume through KEY_1.
The quicksave is the actual town3d save namespace; caller should use an isolated recording user-data directory.

chapters.title: Town, scope and next steps
actions: Pause via normal UI and glide from civic town to whole-town composition.
Finish at exactly600 tour seconds/14400 tour frames (preview90s/2160), excluding measured boot prefix.
Report actual outcomes/limits honestly; no direct agent/nav/room/Simstate writes or forced social results.

allowed_core_entry: Actual viewport input -> existing Main/LifeMode -> Sim transactions; public start_life selection only. Read-only Sim queries/signals supply QA evidence. Pre-roll uses public LifeMode.start_life(aria), speed keys, live waiting to tick90, and LifeMode.begin_select().
prohibited: Direct agent placement or option/needs writes
Clock or Simstate assignments by the director
Treating architectural inspection as resident travel
narration_notes: No extra subtitle overlay is created by the harness. A small top chapter label identifies actual gameplay versus camera inspection.
Actions may complete before their chapter ends; report stores actual frame/tick outcomes.
Actual counter_1 and cafe1f_counter may share one counter mesh while advertising different actions; narrate the visible choice instead of promising fun.
MovieWriter full route includes a full-route-only meal and social attempt; preview prioritizes bounded essential traversal, counter and save/load coverage.
No performance/VRAM, streaming, universal collision, natural-hydrology or all-room-playthrough claim.
